doc: PROFILE.md 7.1: '**`readers.las` `ignore_missing_vlrs`.** Lets the reader carry on past a VLR it cannot use instead of refusing the file. By default `readers.las` refuses a file whose VLR block it cannot walk to the end — a record header that runs off the end of the file, or a record whose declared payload length runs past the start of the point data — and writes no output. With the option set the reader stops reading VLRs at that record, keeps the ones it already has, and returns the file's points normally.'  stages/readers.las.rst carries the reader's VLR Options -- `ignore_vlr` ('A comma-separated list of "userid/record_id" pairs specifying VLR records that should not be loaded.') and the options beside it -- but ships no sentence for `ignore_missing_vlrs`; that gap is recorded in EVIDENCE and the option is specified in the profile instead.  The option only takes effect on a VLR block the reader cannot walk, so on a sound cloud it changes nothing: all one thousand points are still read.
